lede: The biggest item this week is Wednesday's San Miguel County BOCC meeting, where three Land Use Code amendments go to public hearing — including changes to who qualifies as an owner under workforce-housing rules, a wildfire-area code update, and a continued hearing on nonconforming lots, all heading toward formal votes. The Open Space Commission kicks things off Monday with a real decision on the Valley Floor River Trail alignment. The Housing Authority Subcommittee also takes up a deed-restriction variance request, and Mountain Village's Design Review Board weighs in on three multifamily projects Thursday.

notable.stake: Commissioners pick one of three Valley Floor River Trail alignments near wetlands.
